name: What steps are involved in preparing interior walls before painting?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in preparing interior walls before painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper interior wall painting requires repairing drywall defects before applying any primer or paint. A professional crew starts by filling nail holes, patching stress cracks or gouges, smoothing uneven drywall joints, and sanding surfaces flat. Masking tape and drop cloths protect trim, baseboards, and flooring. Primer is applied over fresh drywall mud or bare patches so the topcoat absorbs evenly without flashing. Skipping repair work leaves flaws visible under final paint, especially on walls with satin or semi-gloss sheens. Once the prep work is complete, two coats of quality interior paint provide uniform coverage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prep involves repairing holes and cracks, sanding patches smooth, protecting trim and floors, and spot-priming bare drywall before rolling two finish coats.
